description_en: Invokes DescribeIpInfo to authenticate whether a specified IP address is a Content Delivery Network (CDN) point of presence IP address
description_zh: 调用DescribeIpInfo验证指定的IP是否为阿里云CDN节点的IP地址
name: DescribeIpInfo

parameters.help_en: The IP address to query. Batch queries are not supported
parameters.name: ip

CdnIp.description_en:
Indicates whether the IP address is a Content Delivery Network (CDN) point of presence IP address.

True: The IP address belongs to a CDN point of presence.

False: The IP address does not belong to a CDN point of presence
CdnIp.description_zh:
是否属于阿里云CDN节点。

True：属于。

False：不属于

ISP.description_en: The Chinese name of the ISP to which the IP address belongs

IspEname.description_en: The English name of the Internet service provider (ISP) to which the IP address belongs

Region.description_en: The Chinese name of the region to which the IP address belongs

RegionEname.description_en: The English name of the region to which the IP address belongs
